newsitem.title: USA: Giant Cement sees increased volumes.
newsitem.headline: Giant Cement sees increased volumes.

text.p: Giant Cement Holding Inc said on Monday it expects increased cement shipping volumes in 1997 compared with 1996 and it expects to sell its production for the year.
Giant Cement, which reported improved second quarter results, said in a statement it should realize production gains in the second half of 1997.
Demand for cement remains strong in both of the market areas of the company, cement production and resource recovery, the company said.
Giant Cement's resource recovery revenues are expected to continue to grow, but at a slower rate than the 31 percent growth it reported in the first half of the year, the company said.
